SET @prov_c := '%s';
SET @id:= '%s';
SET @cat_id := '%s';
SET @send :=  IF((SELECT active FROM sys_report WHERE cat_id = @cat_id and id = @id )=1,0,2);
SET @b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET @start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_ddd3(
  id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  hospcode varchar(5) NOT NULL,
  areacode varchar(8) NOT NULL,
  flag_sent varchar(1) NOT NULL,
  date_com varchar(14) NOT NULL,
  b_year varchar(4) NOT NULL,
	op  int(11) DEFAULT 0,
	op10  int(11) DEFAULT 0,
	op11  int(11) DEFAULT 0,
	op12  int(11) DEFAULT 0,
	op1  int(11) DEFAULT 0,
	op2  int(11) DEFAULT 0,
	op3  int(11) DEFAULT 0,
	op4  int(11) DEFAULT 0,
	op5  int(11) DEFAULT 0,
	op6  int(11) DEFAULT 0,
	op7  int(11) DEFAULT 0,
	op8  int(11) DEFAULT 0,
	op9  int(11) DEFAULT 0,
	dd  DECIMAL(50,4) DEFAULT 0.0000,
	dd10  DECIMAL(50,4) DEFAULT 0.0000,
	dd11  DECIMAL(50,4) DEFAULT 0.0000,
	dd12  DECIMAL(50,4) DEFAULT 0.0000,
	dd1  DECIMAL(50,4) DEFAULT 0.0000,
	dd2  DECIMAL(50,4) DEFAULT 0.0000,
	dd3  DECIMAL(50,4) DEFAULT 0.0000,
	dd4  DECIMAL(50,4) DEFAULT 0.0000,
	dd5  DECIMAL(50,4) DEFAULT 0.0000,
	dd6  DECIMAL(50,4) DEFAULT 0.0000,
	dd7  DECIMAL(50,4) DEFAULT 0.0000,
	dd8  DECIMAL(50,4) DEFAULT 0.0000,
	dd9  DECIMAL(50,4) DEFAULT 0.0000,
PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year),
	KEY (hospcode),
	KEY (areacode),
	KEY (b_year)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

DELETE FROM s_ddd3 WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);

INSERT IGNORE INTO s_ddd3
(
SELECT @id,h.hoscode,CONCAT(h.provcode,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.distcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.subdistcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.mu),-2)) as areacode
			,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i') as d_com,@b_year+543
,op,op10,op11,op12,op1,op2,op3,op4,op5,op6,op7,op8,op9
,dd,dd10,dd11,dd12,dd1,dd2,dd3,dd4,dd5,dd6,dd7,dd8,dd9
FROM
chospital h INNER JOIN 
(SELECT HOSPCODE,op,op10,op11,op12,op1,op2,op3,op4,op5,op6,op7,op8,op9
FROM s_1ddd_opvisit WHERE b_year=(@b_year+543) GROUP BY hospcode ) o ON h.hoscode=o.hospcode
LEFT JOIN
(SELECT  t.HOSPCODE
,SUM(t.mgTotal/t.O) dd
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SERV,'%m') IN(10) ,(t.mgTotal/t.O),0)) dd10
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SERV,'%m') IN(11) ,(t.mgTotal/t.O),0)) dd11
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SERV,'%m') IN(12) ,(t.mgTotal/t.O),0)) dd12
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SERV,'%m') IN(1) ,(t.mgTotal/t.O),0)) dd1
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SERV,'%m') IN(2) ,(t.mgTotal/t.O),0)) dd2
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SERV,'%m') IN(3) ,(t.mgTotal/t.O),0)) dd3
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SERV,'%m') IN(4) ,(t.mgTotal/t.O),0)) dd4
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SERV,'%m') IN(5) ,(t.mgTotal/t.O),0)) dd5
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SERV,'%m') IN(6) ,(t.mgTotal/t.O),0)) dd6
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SERV,'%m') IN(7) ,(t.mgTotal/t.O),0)) dd7
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SERV,'%m') IN(8) ,(t.mgTotal/t.O),0)) dd8
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SERV,'%m') IN(9) ,(t.mgTotal/t.O),0)) dd9
FROM t_ddd_op t 
GROUP BY HOSPCODE ) m ON o.HOSPCODE=m.HOSPCODE
);

zone.label: เขตสุขภาพ
zone.query: SELECT h.zone_code as a_code ,h.zone_name as a_name, SUM("op") as "op" ,SUM("dd") as "ddd" ,SUM("op10") as "op10" ,SUM("dd10") as "ddd10" ,SUM("op11") as "op11" ,SUM("dd11") as "ddd11" ,SUM("op12") as "op12" ,SUM("dd12") as "ddd12" ,SUM("op1") as "op1" ,SUM("dd1") as "ddd1" ,SUM("op2") as "op2" ,SUM("dd2") as "ddd2" ,SUM("op3") as "op3" ,SUM("dd3") as "ddd3" ,SUM("op3") as "op4" ,SUM("dd4") as "ddd4" ,SUM("op5") as "op5" ,SUM("dd5") as "ddd5" ,SUM("op6") as "op6" ,SUM("dd6") as "ddd6" ,SUM("op7") as "op7" ,SUM("dd7") as "ddd7" ,SUM("op8") as "op8" ,SUM("dd8") as "ddd8" ,SUM("op9") as "op9" ,SUM("dd9") as "ddd9"  FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) AND (cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) GROUP BY h.zone_code,h.zone_name ORDER BY h.zone_code

service_plan.query: SELECT h.splevel as a_code ,h.splevel as a_name ,   		 SUM(op) as op 		,SUM(dd) as ddd 		,SUM(op10) as op10 		,SUM(dd10) as ddd10 		,SUM(op11) as op11 		,SUM(dd11) as ddd11 		,SUM(op12) as op12 		,SUM(dd12) as ddd12 		,SUM(op1) as op1 		,SUM(dd1) as ddd1 		,SUM(op2) as op2 		,SUM(dd2) as ddd2 		,SUM(op3) as op3 		,SUM(dd3) as ddd3 		,SUM(op3) as op4 		,SUM(dd4) as ddd4 		,SUM(op5) as op5 		,SUM(dd5) as ddd5 		,SUM(op6) as op6 		,SUM(dd6) as ddd6 		,SUM(op7) as op7 		,SUM(dd7) as ddd7 		,SUM(op8) as op8 		,SUM(dd8) as ddd8 		,SUM(op9) as op9 		,SUM(dd9) as ddd9  FROM (SELECT * FROM ccmihosp WHERE byear={{YEAR}}) as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hcode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} JOIN chospital as c ON c.hoscode = h.hcode WHERE (c.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (c.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (c.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (c.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (c.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (c.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (c.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (c.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (h.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY CAST(regbed AS DECIMAL) DESC
